summary: Tested admin apply-for-leave and apply-for-WFH flows for super_admin, HR and manager plus non-regression for employee. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed. Frontend: buttons visible, dialogs open, submissions succeed with toast, POSTs return 200; rows visible immediately for HR and super_admin. Manager (Alex) submissions succeed and persist in DB but the newly-filed row is not visible in /admin/leave and /admin/wfh under 'My team only' scope because the manager toggle is disabled (locked ON) and the team-scoped list does not include the manager's own self-applied requests. Request statement explicitly accepts this behavior.

integration_issues.issue: Manager's own newly-filed leave/WFH row does not appear in the admin list because the 'My team only' switch is disabled (locked ON for managers) and the team-scoped query excludes the manager's own requests. Row does persist (verified via /leave/mine and /wfh/mine). Consider either (a) including the current manager's own requests in the team scope, or (b) allowing managers to toggle team-only off, or (c) adding a 'My requests' scope.

issues: Dialogs use the browser's default HTML date picker (input type=date) rather than the shadcn Calendar component — pre-existing on the employee dialogs which are now reused in admin, so consistency is maintained but recommend replacing with shadcn Calendar for polish.
Accessibility warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' for DialogContent on all apply dialogs — add DialogDescription.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: Fix manager visibility of their own self-filed leave/WFH in /admin/leave and /admin/wfh (currently invisible under team-only scope which manager cannot disable).
OPTIONAL a11y: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to ApplyDialog components in MyLeave.jsx and MyWFH.jsx to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLeave.jsx uses `import { ApplyDialog as LeaveApplyDialog } from '@/pages/employee/MyLeave'` — good re-use, keeps employee UX untouched.
AdminWFH.jsx doesn't re-fetch balances (WFH has none needed) — fine. Both pages correctly refresh list after onCreated.

Manager toggle for team-only is disabled without a fallback path to view own self-applied items — logical hole introduced by this feature. Recommend surfacing self items in team scope for managers/HR/admin.
Both ApplyDialog components use native <input type='date'> instead of shadcn Calendar — a stylistic inconsistency across the app.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for happy paths; manager visibility caveat noted as UX gap not functional failure
